content.title: Generic Industrial PV-2000-PVC Ball Valve, 2 in Socket Weld, PVC Body, PTFE Seat, 150 psi
content.short_description: PV-2000-PVC is a 2 in socket weld ball valve with PVC body and PTFE seats, rated to 150 psi and 180 C max temperature.
content.long_description:
The PV-2000-PVC is a ball-type valve configured for socket weld connection at a nominal size of 2 in. The body is constructed from PVC, with PTFE used for the seat material, providing a bearing surface for the ball in shut-off and throttling service.

Pressure rating for this valve is 150 psi, with a maximum operating temperature of 180 C. These ratings define the operating envelope for the valve; system designers should confirm process conditions fall within these limits before specification.

Connection to piping is via socket weld, requiring the mating pipe or fitting to be prepared for socket weld joining at the 2 in nominal size. This valve is categorized under Industrial Components > Fluid Handling > Industrial Valves for fluid isolation and flow control applications.
